ModuleName: Generating Interactive Activities and Custom Materials

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists the topics and subtopics covered in this module — including interactive activity templates, matching, flashcards, cloze passages, crossword puzzles, and custom materials — giving learners and instructors a structured overview of what the module contains.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Interactive Activity Templates
Artifacts.Description: Explains what interactive activity templates are, why they improve learning outcomes, and what types are available in PreseMaker, serving as a conceptual introduction for instructors before they begin building activities.

Artifacts.Name: Matching and Flashcard Activities
Artifacts.Description: Describes how matching and flashcard activities work in PreseMaker — including how they are built from key terms and why they support vocabulary retention — helping instructors understand when and how to use these two activity types.

Artifacts.Name: Cloze Passages and Crossword Puzzles
Artifacts.Description: Covers how PreseMaker automatically generates cloze passages and crossword puzzles from a module's key terms, explaining the pedagogical value of each and how instructors can deploy them without manual construction.

Artifacts.Name: Generating Custom Materials
Artifacts.Description: Explains how to use PreseMaker's custom materials generator to create freeform instructional content — such as reference guides or bespoke exercises — that falls outside the platform's standard activity templates, guiding instructors through the process.

Artifacts.Name: Locating Artifacts in the Module Index
Artifacts.Description: Teaches instructors how to use the Module Index to locate, revisit, and manage all generated activities, quizzes, and custom materials produced within a module, establishing it as the central hub for output navigation.
